topic: DeepSeek capped its free chat; run the open weights locally
title: DeepSeek Runs Tonight: Three Moves
description: DeepSeek capped its free chat this week. The open weights run on your gaming PC tonight.
hook_candidates: Your free DeepSeek chat now has a quota.
Some users hit the daily cap in under two hours.
That free chat ran fifty-nine point two trillion tokens last week.
DeepSeek locked your week-old chats behind a quota.
No paid tier escapes this cap. None exists.
The file that replaces it is nine gigabytes.
Forty thousand characters per prompt is now the wall.
Stop paying attention to the quota. Run the weights.
Three moves and DeepSeek runs on your box tonight.
You already own the way out of this quota.
narration_full: Three moves and DeepSeek runs on your box tonight. The free chat capped you this week. The notice blames insufficient computing capacity. Step one: install Ollama, the runtime that loads model files. Step two: run one command to pull the fourteen-billion distill. That's eight point nine nine gigabytes of model file. Got twenty-four gigabytes of memory? The bigger distill is nineteen point nine gigabytes of model file. Step three: load it and ask something. It answers. The catch: a distill is the student, not the big model. The gym added a turnstile; your home barbell is lighter. No quota, no key, no bill. DeepSeek lives on your box tonight.

analogy.vehicle: a gym that installed a turnstile versus the barbell you take home
analogy.mapping: the capped free chat is the gym rationing visits during a crunch; the open weights are the barbell in your garage, lift whenever you like
analogy.limit: the home barbell is lighter, the local distill is a student of the big model, not the model itself
